mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(0) FROM mes_building_machine_part_no_process GROUP BY order_number WHERE date( create_time )= date(#{now})

SELECT mbmpnp.machine_part_scheduling_id AS scheduling_id, ANY_VALUE(mbmpnp.order_number) AS orderNumber, ANY_VALUE(cp.id) 'project.id', ANY_VALUE(cp.serial_number) 'project.serialNumber', ANY_VALUE(cp.short_name) 'project.name', ANY_VALUE(su.NAME) AS userName, ANY_VALUE(mbmpnp.ask_complete_time) AS askCompleteTime, sum( mbmpnp.quantity ), 0 AS boolProcess FROM mes_building_machine_part_no_process mbmpnp LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = mbmpnp.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cp.user_id = su.id WHERE mbmpnp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbmpnp.bool_process = 0 GROUP BY mbmpnp.machine_part_scheduling_id

SELECT SUM(mbmpnp.quantity) AS quantity, ANY_VALUE(mbmpnp.order_number) AS order_number, ANY_VALUE(steel.name) AS partType, ANY_VALUE(part.serial_number) AS serial_number, mbmpnp.specification AS specification, mbmpnp.material AS material, ROUND((SUM(mbmpnp.quantity * mbmpnp.single_length * mbmpnp.wastage_rate) / 1000), 3) AS totalLength, SUM(mbmpnp.quantity * mbmpnp.single_weight) AS totalNetWeight FROM mes_building_machine_part_no_process mbmpnp LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part part ON part.id = mbmpnp.product_id AND part.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification steel ON part.steel_id = steel.id AND steel.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE mbmpnp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbmpnp.machine_part_scheduling_id = #{schedulingId} GROUP BY part.steel_id, mbmpnp.material, mbmpnp.specification

SELECT any_value(part.serial_number) AS serialNumber, part.thick AS thickness, part.material, sum( mbtp.task_quantity) quantity, sum( mbtp.task_quantity * part.net_weight ) AS totalNetWeight FROM mes_building_task_process mbtp LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part part ON part.id = mbtp.product_id WHERE mbtp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND part.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtp.sequence = 0 AND mbtp.machine_part_scheduling_id = #{schedulingId} GROUP BY part.thick, part.material ORDER BY part.thick
